provenance.variant: UTC as defined since 1961-01-01: 1961-1971 offsets with rate terms, integer leap seconds from 1972
provenance.conditions: TAI - UTC = offset_s + (MJD_UTC - mjd_reference) * rate_s_per_day from jd_utc_start; the 1972+ steps are cross-checked against NAIF DELTET/DELTA_AT at build time.
provenance.uncertainty: Exact by definition (IERS Bulletin C / BIH); valid until the next announced leap second.

provenance.variant: IERS EOP 20 C04, daily at 0h UTC, 1962-01-01 to 2026-06-30
provenance.conditions: Polar motion, UT1-UTC, LOD and celestial pole offsets as observed; after the last row the orientation holds its last values with a growing, declared error.
provenance.uncertainty: Per-row published 1-sigma: 0.02 arcsec (~0.6 m) and 1.5 ms (~0.7 m at the equator) in 1969; ~50 microarcsec and ~20 microseconds today.

products.model: IAU 2006 precession and IAU 2000A nutation (IERS Conventions 2010, chapter 5) evaluated by ERFA eraXys06a (pyerfa 2.0.1.5, from the IAU SOFA library)

provenance.variant: CIP X, Y and CIO locator s, daily at 0h TT, 1960-01-01 to 2051-12-31
provenance.conditions: Pure IAU model; observed corrections dX, dY come from eop_c04. Interpolated with 8-point Lagrange in the simulation.
provenance.uncertainty: IAU 2006/2000A model accuracy ~0.2 mas against VLBI before dX/dY; interpolation error tested below 1 microarcsec.

provenance.variant: geocentric Moon, ICRF, TDB, 1960-01-01 to 2051-01-01, piecewise Chebyshev
provenance.conditions: Chebyshev interpolation of DE440 at Gauss nodes per span; analytic velocity; verified against SPICE at 2000 random instants at build time.
provenance.uncertainty: Interpolation below 2 mm / 2e-8 m/s of DE440; DE440 itself is accurate to ~1 m (Moon, LLR) and better for the inner planets (Park et al. 2021).
